title: Not worth it! Do not waste your money!!!
text: Do not get this subscription! There is nothing full size about the products allure throws in this tiny boxes! They had Christmas special deluxe box surprise if you would subscribe for a year and plus you would save more! I regret subscribing and when I called them to cancel or get refund for the remaining of 11 month they were very rude about it and refused to give me refund since it’s an annual subscription. I wish I had done more research before subscribing. Surprise box had some full size products but nothing special. Very dissatisfied and disappointed. I feel like all the items that were select are either expired or were about to be thrown out so they came up with the beauty box concept. Waste of money and time because they never deliver on time! Disgusting!!!
label: negative
